bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
py="$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 71
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 72
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 73
rows=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT DISTINCT t.chat_id,d.telegram_message_id FROM room_status_message_edits q JOIN room_source_events e ON e.event_id=q.room_event_id JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.delivery_id=q.delivery_id JOIN posting_topics t ON t.topic_id=d.posting_topic_id WHERE q.state='needs_reconcile' AND e.kind='finished' AND d.status='sent' AND d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL AND t.enabled=TRUE AND t.purpose IN ('room','announcement') ORDER BY t.chat_id,d.telegram_message_id LIMIT 4") || exit 74
if test -z "$rows"; then echo ROOM_READBACK_TARGET_COUNT=0; else
 count=$(printf '%s\n' "$rows" | wc -l)
 echo ROOM_READBACK_TARGET_COUNT="$count"
 printf '%s\n' "$rows" | while IFS='|' read -r chat_id message_id; do
  if "$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" room_public_readback --chat-id "$chat_id" --message-id "$message_id"; then
   echo ROOM_READBACK_RESULT=PASS
  else
   echo ROOM_READBACK_RESULT=NOT_CONFIRMED
  fi
 done
fi
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 75
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 76
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_SESSION=ACTIVE
echo ROOM_PUBLIC_READBACK_CHECK_COMPLETE
